framework: NetCracker NextGenCI / Playwright E2E Test Runner
cloudProvider: NetCracker (Artifactory at artifactorycn.netcracker.com; runner tag: NETCRACKER)
cicdPlatform: GitLab CI with NextGenCI components (bootstrap@1.1.10, ng-buildx@1.6.0, app-chart@1.7.0, application-dd@1.9.0)
containerization: Docker multistage — 4 stages: transfer, helm-processor (openjdk21:21.0.5.11.01), artifact (scratch), runner
orchestration: Helm (app-chart/); chart renamed from atp3-playwright-runner to APPLICATION_NAME at build time
deploymentStrategy: Not active (workflow: never); fill APPLICATION_NAME, RUNNER_IMAGE, TRANSFER_IMAGE placeholders before enabling
patterns: GitLab CI pipeline with build-sonar, build, package, and publish stages (disabled by workflow: never until placeholders are filled)
Multistage Dockerfile: transfer → helm-processor (openjdk21) → artifact (scratch export) → runner (${RUNNER_IMAGE})
Helm chart in app-chart/ for Kubernetes deployment of the test runner; chart name dynamically set to APPLICATION_NAME
SonarQube analysis via sonar-scanner-cli:11 on MR and protected branches (allows failure)
Artifacts published to NetCracker Artifactory under group com.netcracker.cloud.atp.project.applications-entities
conventions: Keep environment-specific values out of source control (use .env and secrets management)
Pin base image and dependency versions in Dockerfiles and CI configs
Use infrastructure-as-code or version-controlled config where possible
constraints: CI/CD pipeline disabled by default (workflow: never) — must fill APPLICATION_NAME, RUNNER_IMAGE, TRANSFER_IMAGE, and REPLACE_SONAR_PROJECT_KEY before enabling
Runner image (${RUNNER_IMAGE}) must be a NetCracker ATP Playwright runner image published to artifactorycn.netcracker.com
Test runner copies TestGeneration/ to /tmp/clone and runs as non-root 'runner' user
Build job timeout: 20 minutes; artifact expiration: 30 minutes
projectSpecificNotes: NetCracker ATP3 Playwright runner project. GitLab CI uses NextGenCI reusable components with NetCracker Artifactory as the container and Helm registry. Pipeline is disabled (workflow: never) until APPLICATION_NAME and image placeholders are filled. Helm chart base is atp3-playwright-runner, renamed at build time. Update this file when environment targets, monitoring, or deployment strategy are decided. Answers ported from the already-verified .opencode/skills/infrastructure-context/project-config.json (cross-harness project; .opencode/ was initialized first).
